model.name: R20.1: URL files open the preview drawer on click — regression fix.
model.description: REGRESSION: clicking a .url/.html.url file item in the room tree does NOT open the ContentPreviewer drawer. Likely caused by 862868bfe partial-commit (R19.84/85 iframe-zoom half-wire broke the .url inline preview→drawer path). FIX: clicking a url-type FileUnit MUST open the drawer with the two-button preview (R19.77: Open in preview + Open in new tab). Test-first: RED test reproduces the failure BEFORE the fix.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "url files do not open the drawer."

intendedChain.useCase: fileItem.openDrawer — click url-type item → drawer opens with preview buttons
intendedChain.test: RED: click .url file item in room → assert drawer opens + two buttons visible. Currently FAILS (drawer does not open).
